# Upstream 922a9f046c4a2714edf2b76fec3d1862dcd56ae3:
# sky/client/cli/command.py:1252-1255 defines launch --dryrun as non-executing.
# skygo plan is its smaller analogue; neither success nor rejection submits.
taskfile success.json success
skygo plan -f success.json
stdout '^local\n$'
! stderr .
skygo --json plan -f success.json
stdout '"target": *"local"'
! stdout '"id"'
! stderr .
skygo jobs list
stdout '^ID +TARGET +STATE\n$'

! skygo plan -f missing-target.yaml
stderr 'failed_precondition: no eligible target'
! stdout .
# CPU and memory requests are admitted against host inventory. This is
# non-executing planning, not CPU or memory limit enforcement.
skygo plan -f resources.yaml
stdout '^local\n$'
! stderr .
skygo --json plan -f resources.yaml
stdout '"target": *"local"'
! stdout '"id"'
! stderr .

# Images and enforced limits remain unsupported by local execution.
! skygo plan -f limits.yaml
stderr 'failed_precondition: no eligible target'
! stdout .
! skygo plan -f image.yaml
stderr 'failed_precondition: no eligible target'
! stdout .
! skygo run -f image.yaml --request-id rejected
stderr 'retry with --request-id rejected'
! stdout .
skygo --json jobs list
! stdout '"id"'
! stdout '"next_page_token"'

-- missing-target.yaml --
argv: [unused]
target: unavailable
-- resources.yaml --
argv: [unused]
cpu_millis: 1000
memory_bytes: 1024
-- limits.yaml --
argv: [unused]
cpu_millis: 1000
memory_bytes: 1024
cpu_limit_millis: 1000
memory_limit_bytes: 1024
-- image.yaml --
argv: [unused]
image: example.invalid/workload:latest
